text:
sam: Heads-up: I'm putting a short merge cordon on release/v2.4 for ~30m to finish the RC bump + changelog sync. Please hold merges unless it's a hotfix.
priya: ack, will freeze my branch merges. planning to rebase after the bump.
alex: @sam can you paste the commit hash you want bumped? need it for the cherry-pick PR.
sam: bump target is 9f3a2d1 (from main). I'll open the bump PR in a min.
ci-bot: [ci] enqueued: release-bump-9f3a2d1 pipeline started — https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/9876 (status: running)
mike: quick changelog check: does the release notes already include the autoscaler fix + KV cache perf note?
jen: I added a changelog draft for autoscaler in #3456, but KV cache note is missing. pinging @alex for the perf blurb.
alex: I can write a short blurb. putting it in #3456 now.
priya: about flaky tests — our green-sweep showed 3 intermittent failures in worker-integration tests. any volunteers to look?
mike: I can triage one of them (test_worker_timeout). saw stacktrace pointing at grpc reconnect.
jen: there's a rerun job: click the L rerun button or run `./ci/retry_job.sh 9876` — but maybe rerun the specific stage?
priya: I'll kick a targeted rerun: `./ci/retry_job.sh 9876 --stage=integration-workers`
ci-bot: retrigger requested by priya: stage integration-workers requeued (build 9876.2)
ci-bot: build 9876.2 started — will post results here.
mike: if it flakes again, can we quarantine that test and file a flaky ticket? we shouldn't block release for an infra flake.
sam: Agreed. If it fails twice in a row, create a short ticket and mark it as flaky-blocker; we can bypass for the RC.
jen: tagging the test `test_worker_timeout` as quarantined in the pipeline config temporarily. I'll send a follow-up PR to unquarantine after fix.
alex: PR for changelog + perf blurb is up: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/6789 — reviewers: @jen @sam
priya: cherry-pick for bump opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/6790 — includes version bump, changelog link, and release metadata.
sam: thanks. once CI goes green on bump + integration rerun, I'll remove cordon. aiming to lift by +30m.
ci-bot: build 9876.2 completed: status: success (integration-workers green)
priya: nice — any remaining flakes flagged?
mike: none on my end now. looks clean.
jen: changelog updated and approved.
alex: approved the bump PR.
sam: lifting cordon in 2m. if you need an emergency merge, ping me directly. otherwise resume merges after I confirm. :white_check_mark:
priya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy note: release/v2.4 tag created at 9f3a2d1 by sam
sam: done — cordon lifted. thanks for the fast turn-around!
jen: releasing notes to the docs site in a separate PR next.
mike: will follow up on the flaky ticket tomorrow morning.
priya: filing the flaky ticket now with traces + reproduction steps.
ci-bot: archived thread for pipeline 9876
